prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE portrait 9:16 keyframe, an independently composed vertical companion to the reference miniature Chinese departure port. No collage, no crop of landscape.
Continuity reference image 1: exact bright daylight physical scale model, navy gantry cranes, navy hull container ship white aft superstructure, cyan corrugated hero container with black corner fittings and blank ivory side panel, tiny painted workers.
S01 CHINA DEPARTURE. A clearly visible Chinese red flag with yellow stars on a small port flagpole in the upper LEFT, generic dense Chinese coastal apartment buildings and green hills behind port, no famous landmark. The country identity must read immediately. The same navy-hull ship is docked at right, preparing for the voyage to America.
Vertical story composition: near departure cargo and the cyan hero container fill lower-middle foreground, a small forklift and tiny painted workers load kraft cargo. The crane loading path leads diagonally away toward the same ship in middle-right, with a small open sea exit at top-right. Hero container's long side with unobstructed LARGE BLANK IVORY PANEL faces camera at a mild perspective. Camera low elevated macro at the LANDWARD REAR of the cargo movement, looking FORWARD along the pier toward the ocean exit upper-right. We travel with this cargo toward sea. Avoid purely flat isometric catalog view.
Make miniature craft more explicit: premium 1:87 physical diorama, discrete cut concrete model plinth edge at bottom, tiny molded tires, painted toy figures, resin water surface, careful subtle scale-model seams, tilt-shift lens shallow near/far softness with main cyan container sharp. Full frame authored, top14% slightly quiet sky if possible while Chinese flag remains prominent. Sun upper-left, navy/cyan/kraft/ivory colors.
No PNPLINE lettering or any generated logo; panel blank for later real branding. No big English/Chinese text captions. No US flag. One coherent harbor, no airport, no fantasy buildings.
